title: Speed Force vs Negative Speed Force
script: This is The Speed Force. This is The Negative Speed Force. So what's the difference? Most people think Reverse Flash uses Barry's Speed Force. He doesn't. The Speed Force is an extra-dimensional kinetic field generated by Barry Allen running forward in time. But The Negative Speed Force was created by Eobard Thawne to decay and consume kinetic energy. The Speed Force generates motion, while the Negative Speed Force rots it away. Follow for more.
